chunks: Al-Shaykh, may Allah have mercy on him, informed me from Aḥmad ibn Muḥammad, from his father, from al-Ṣaffār, from Aḥmad ibn Muḥammad ibn ʿĪsā, from Abī ʿAbdillāh al-Barqī, from Muḥammad ibn Muṣādif, who said:
I heard Abā ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام saying: Sajdah is only upon the forehead, and there is no sajdah upon the nose.

key_terms.أَبَا عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ: Imam Jaʿfar al-Ṣādiq عليه السلام, the speaker in the narration
key_terms.الْأَنْفِ: the nose, which the report denies as the place of sajdah
key_terms.الْجَبْهَةِ: the forehead, the required place of sajdah in this report

ai.seo_question: Is sajdah in prayer performed on the forehead only, or does the nose also count?
ai.summary: This hadith states a legal ruling concerning sajdah, specifying that the place of prostration is the forehead. It negates the nose as constituting sajdah, making the report relevant to the fiqh of salat and the manner of valid prostration.
